verses.en: The earth is the LORD’S, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
verses.pt: Do Senhor é a terra e a sua plenitude; o mundo e aqueles que nele habitam.
verses.en_web: The earth is Yahweh’s, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell therein.
verses.en_bbe: <A Psalm. Of David.> The earth is the Lord's, with all its wealth; the world and all the people living in it.

verses.en: For he hath founded it upon the seas, and established it upon the floods.
verses.pt: Porque ele a fundou sobre os mares, e a firmou sobre os rios.
verses.en_web: For he has founded it on the seas, and established it on the floods.
verses.en_bbe: For by him it was based on the seas, and made strong on the deep rivers.

verses.en: Who shall ascend into the hill of the LORD? or who shall stand in his holy place?
verses.pt: Quem subirá ao monte do Senhor, ou quem estará no seu lugar santo?
verses.en_web: Who may ascend to Yahweh’s hill? Who may stand in his holy place?
verses.en_bbe: Who may go up into the hill of the Lord? and who may come into his holy place?

verses.en: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; who hath not lifted up his soul unto vanity, nor sworn deceitfully.
verses.pt: Aquele que é limpo de mãos e puro de coração; que não entrega a sua alma à vaidade, nem jura enganosamente.
verses.en_web: He who has clean hands and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul to falsehood, and has not sworn deceitfully.
verses.en_bbe: He who has clean hands and a true heart; whose desire has not gone out to foolish things, who has not taken a false oath.

verses.en: He shall receive the blessing from the LORD, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.
verses.pt: Este receberá do Senhor uma bênção, e a justiça do Deus da sua salvação.
verses.en_web: He shall receive a blessing from Yahweh, righteousness from the God of his salvation.
verses.en_bbe: He will have blessing from the Lord, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.

verses.en: This is the generation of them that seek him, that seek thy face, O Jacob. Selah.
verses.pt: Tal é a geração daqueles que o buscam, daqueles que buscam a tua face, ó Deus de Jacó.
verses.en_web: This is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek your face—even Jacob. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: This is the generation of those whose hearts are turned to you, even to your face, O God of Jacob. (Selah.)

verses.en: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; and be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.
verses.pt: Levantai, ó portas, as vossas cabeças; levantai-vos, ó entradas eternas, e entrará o Rei da Glória.
verses.en_web: Lift up your heads, you gates! Be lifted up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.
verses.en_bbe: Let your heads be lifted up, O doors; be lifted up, O you eternal doors: that the King of glory may come in.

verses.en: Who is this King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.
verses.pt: Quem é o Rei da Glória? O Senhor forte e poderoso, o Senhor poderoso na batalha.
verses.en_web: Who is the King of glory? Yahweh strong and mighty, Yahweh mighty in battle.
verses.en_bbe: Who is the King of glory? The Lord of strength and power, the Lord strong in war.

verses.en: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; even lift them up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.
verses.pt: Levantai, ó portas, as vossas cabeças; levantai-vos, ó entradas eternas, e entrará o Rei da Glória.
verses.en_web: Lift up your heads, you gates; yes, lift them up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.
verses.en_bbe: Let your heads be lifted up, O doors; let them be lifted up, O you eternal doors: that the King of glory may come in.

verses.en: Who is this King of glory? The LORD of hosts, he is the King of glory. Selah.
verses.pt: Quem é esse Rei da Glória? O Senhor dos exércitos; ele é o Rei da Glória.
verses.en_web: Who is this King of glory? Yahweh of Armies is the King of glory! Selah.
verses.en_bbe: Who is the King of glory? The Lord of armies, he is the King of glory. (Selah.)
